summary: Tested Google Calendar integration in Agenda page (backend + frontend). All 4 backend pytest cases pass and all frontend flows work end-to-end.
backend_tests_verified: POST /api/appointments creates appointment AND returns gcal_event_id populated (PASS)
Auth is required on /api/appointments/check-calendar (401 without token) (PASS)
frontend_tests_verified: 'Novo Agendamento' opens dialog with data-testid='check-calendar-btn' present
Filling date=2026-08-12 14:00-16:00 + click check -> data-testid='calendar-conflict-msg' shown with event details
3 suggestion buttons visible (data-testid='suggestion-0/1/2'); clicking suggestion-0 updates time_start (14:00 -> 17:00)
Filling date=2026-08-25 09:00-11:00 + click check -> data-testid='calendar-available-msg' 'Horário livre no Google Calendar' shown
Creating an appointment through UI succeeds; toast configured as 'Agendamento criado + evento Google Calendar' (verified in code line 152 of AgendaPage.jsx)
critical_code_review_comments: Hydration warning in console: <span> inside <option> in AgendaPage work-select (line ~270). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up (the dynamic instrumentation wraps option content in a span). Purely cosmetic React warning.

backend/server.py: _gcal_check_and_create always attempts to create the calendar event synchronously inside create_appointment; on slow Google API responses this will slow down POST /appointments. Consider background task. Not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Created + cleaned up TEST_ prefixed appointments during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google Calendar integration (Agenda) is fully working. Real GCal events created on 2026-08-12, 08-15, 08-20 remain from previous iterations; use 2026-08-25+ for available-slot tests. GCal API is slow (~4-6s); allow long waits in Playwright.
